nodes.title: Focus rings
nodes.note: Three buttons (default ring, custom box-shadow ring, outline removed) and an input whose wrapper draws the ring with :focus-within.

nodes.title: Hidden focus
nodes.note: A skip link that appears on focus, then a clipped link, an off-screen button and a transparent button that all take focus while hidden.

nodes.title: Tab order
nodes.note: Download, Share and Print buttons where Print is drawn a row above the other two, a clickable card with no tab stop, and Done.

nodes.title: Keyboard trap
nodes.note: A non-modal filter bar that keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside itself and ignores Esc.

nodes.title: Embedded form
nodes.note: A cross-origin frame with three buttons between two page buttons.

nodes.title: Embedded editor
nodes.note: A cross-origin frame that keeps every Tab press inside itself.

nodes.title: Transactions table
nodes.note: Thirty rows, each with a link and a button.

nodes.title: Dialogs
nodes.note: Three modal dialog triggers: a correct APG dialog, one that ignores Esc, one that drops focus on close.

nodes.title: Drawers
nodes.note: Drawer triggers: two that drop focus to the body, a clickable row with no tab stop, and a div button that only a click opens.

nodes.title: Menus
nodes.note: A correct APG menu button and a menu that leaves focus on its button.

nodes.title: Popovers
nodes.note: A hover-only tooltip, a popover shown on hover and focus, and an APG disclosure.

nodes.title: Status messages
nodes.note: Buttons that show toasts: into an existing status region, with a new live container, taking focus, and one removed after 1 s.

nodes.title: Card nickname form
nodes.note: Two fields; Save marks both invalid, with one error tied by aria-errormessage and one only next to its field.

nodes.title: Composite widgets
nodes.note: An APG tablist with roving tabindex, a toolbar that leaves all three buttons in the tab order, and Done.

nodes.title: Detail panel
nodes.note: Show details reveals a non-modal aside in the middle of the DOM, followed by Next page.

nodes.title: Delivery address dialog
nodes.note: Correct modal dialog: focus moves to Street, Tab wraps inside, Esc closes and returns focus.

nodes.title: Card nickname dialog
nodes.note: Modal dialog that ignores Esc; Cancel closes it and returns focus.

nodes.title: Change PIN dialog
nodes.note: Modal dialog that closes on Esc and leaves focus on the page body.

nodes.title: Card limits drawer
nodes.note: Drawer that opens with focus on the page body; Tab reaches its controls later.

nodes.title: Billing address drawer
nodes.note: Drawer that opens with focus on the page body and holds nothing focusable.

nodes.title: Payment details drawer
nodes.note: Drawer opened from a clickable row with no tab stop.

nodes.title: Card settings drawer
nodes.note: Drawer opened from a div button that Enter and Space do not operate.

nodes.title: Actions menu
nodes.note: APG menu: focus on Copy, Esc returns focus to Actions.

nodes.title: Export menu
nodes.note: Menu that leaves focus on Export; the next Tab goes to Help.

nodes.title: Fees tooltip
nodes.note: Tooltip shown only on hover.

nodes.title: Card art popover
nodes.note: Popover shown on hover and on focus, with a Learn more link.

nodes.title: Filters panel
nodes.note: APG disclosure panel with two checkboxes.

nodes.title: Changes saved toast
nodes.note: Toast inserted into the status region that exists from page load.

nodes.title: Payment sent toast
nodes.note: Toast inserted together with its own aria-live container.

nodes.title: Card archived toast
nodes.note: Toast outside any live region that takes focus.

nodes.title: Account number copied toast
nodes.note: Toast inserted into the status region and removed after 1 s.

nodes.title: Card nickname errors
nodes.note: Both fields marked invalid; the nickname error is tied by aria-errormessage, the ZIP error only sits next to its field.

nodes.title: Payment details panel
nodes.note: Non-modal aside with View receipt and Download; Tab leaves it for Next page.
